title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UEFA's official qualification results, corroborated by contemporaneous match reporting. 
  Resolution Rule : Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The competition's standard name.
